ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Доброта» (dobrota, 'kindness') is 'kindness' throughout and «добро» (dobro) 'good'; «пристрастие» (pristrastie) is 'partiality', so that the closing reading's «любовь пристрастная» (lyubov' pristrastnaya, 'partial love') echoes it. The attribution printed «Люси Малоpu» (with Latin letters) is the usual «Люси Малори» (Lyusi Malori), Lucy Mallory.
Source observation: [8] attribution printed «Люси Малоpu» with Latin «p» and «u» (transcription slip for «Малори»); rendered Lucy Mallory.
